# Scheduling (cms-api)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`media`](../../flows/media/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

The one job runner of cms-api: modules start their jobs (media purge, reviewer cleanup) through it from their `jobs/` folder.

## Techniques

`setInterval` with an unref'd timer, so a job never keeps the process alive; errors go to the job's `onError`. With several replicas every one runs the job, so a job must be safe to overlap.

## Technologies

Node timers.

## Entry points

`startIntervalJob`, `IntervalJobOptions`.

## Where to change what

A new job: a `jobs/<Name>.job.ts` in the owning module that calls `startIntervalJob` and only calls use cases (layer rules, [cms-api rules](../../apps/cms-api/RULES.md)).
